note: Lender package rows for diligence-tracker.csv (ids B01...). The lender's own checklist governs; map it onto these rows. phase: phase1 (package to the lender early), phase2 (third-party reports, approval), decision (commitment conditions before the go/no-go date). Tags for --exclude: real-estate, seller-note, qoe, co-borrower. Source ids in why are files in data/sources/.

requests.request: Lender's own checklist and forms received
Personal financial statement on the lender's form for each 20%+ owner and guarantor, dated within 90 days
SBA Form 1919 for each co-borrower, on the lender's copy
Buyer personal tax returns (years per lender)
requests.why: Personal and global cash flow (source sba-sop-50-10-8-1-global-cash-flow)

requests.request: Buyer resume and management plan: industry experience, who runs day-to-day operations
Equity source documentation: statements showing funds, gift letters, other sources
Business plan and projections with assumptions
requests.why: Evaluated but not relied on for coverage (source sba-sop-50-10-8-1-projections)

requests.request: Sources and uses and pro forma balance sheet
Seller business tax returns and year-end statements, three most recent years
Seller interim P&L and balance sheet within 120 days, with the same period prior year
Seller-signed IRS transcript authorization (Form 4506-C or 8821) on the lender's copy
Copy of the premises lease to the lender
Signed LOI to the lender
Term sheets compared in lender.md and one signed
requests.why: Choose the lender on the same basis

requests.request: Business valuation ordered by the lender (track status)
QoE ordered or buyer-commissioned QoE accepted by the lender (track status)
Lender site visit scheduled with the seller's agreement
Real estate appraisal and any environmental report (track status)
requests.why: Lender-ordered when real estate is in the deal

requests.request: Credit approval and commitment letter received; conditions copied into lender.md
Seller note standby agreement drafted (if the note counts as equity)
Purchase agreement draft, then signed copy with all schedules and amendments, to the lender
Insurance binders and any life insurance the lender requires
All commitment conditions cleared before disbursement (equity, standby, appraisals, collateral)
